purpose: Blind, full-project validation of model-owned observation, processor selection, governed loading, typed control, transactional execution, and model-owned post-action evaluation for seven processor families.

blindness_contract.allowed_confirmation_behavior: Approve only the exact pending action selected by the model and exposed by the governed workflow. Confirmation text must not add a family, target, view, coverage axis, identifier, or control value.

agent_input.initial_prompt: 请检查这个完整工程的整体混音状态。自主申请你需要的观察，只处理你有足够证据确认的问题。你可以按需要加载或使用合格效果器并调控；每次处理后自行决定还需要观察什么，并继续到没有明确问题或无法安全继续为止。
agent_input.continuation_prompt: 继续基于最初的完整工程目标工作；如果没有足够证据、无需继续或无法安全继续，请停止并说明原因。
agent_input.confirmation_prompt: 确认当前待执行方案；如果状态已变化或证据不足，请停止，不要猜测。

sealed_truth.access_rule: The runner process must not open this artifact or receive its path. Only the offline evaluator may open it after a run report or labelled partial report is closed.

evaluation_report.evaluation_access_rule: The evaluator opens sealed truth only after the run report or labelled partial report is atomically closed.

result_contract.evaluator_disagreement_rule: A model-selected alternative family is evaluator_disagreement when it is evidence-backed and fully governed. It is not automatically an Agent conformance failure and does not credit the sealed expected family.
result_contract.not_exercised_rule: A sealed family that the model never selects is recorded as not_exercised_by_model. The runner must not reveal or prompt that family to obtain coverage.
result_contract.model_no_op_rule: No mutation after adequate autonomous observation is a valid model outcome, but it does not exercise a typed family.
result_contract.model_blocked_rule: A fail-closed stop caused by insufficient evidence, PCA, identity, coverage, confirmation, topology, transaction, or fresh verification is recorded with the exact auditable blocker.

family_coverage_policy.family_exercised_definition: The model selected the family, the exact identifier stayed within the PCA-eligible set, load/qualification passed, the typed controller reached an applied or bounded fail-closed terminal receipt, and all required evidence is present.
family_coverage_policy.family_full_path_definition: family_exercised plus an applied transaction, readback, snapshot verification, and fresh model-requested post-action evaluation
family_coverage_policy.official_run_repetition_policy: No prompt-steered replay. A project may be replayed once only for an independently established transport or infrastructure failure, using the same public manifest and neutral prompt; the replay is labelled and never silently substituted.

agent_conformance_pass: no server-injected family, target, view, coverage, identifier, plugin path, vendor mapping, or parameter ID
every mutation is attributable to a model decision and a governed typed path
PCA remains the final loading-admission authority; live typed inspection and execution remain the concrete-control authority
candidate-set membership, confirmation, transaction, readback, snapshot, rollback, and fresh-observation gates are honored
Spectral Dynamics never executes and Clipper never enters the Limiter path
mixing_layer_readiness_pass: no unresolved high-severity safety or bypass finding remains
global runtime stays within 7200 seconds or the overrun has an accepted infrastructure-only explanation
